notes: Existing product storage may be extended with supplier_id. Existing stock and availability behavior must be preserved.
Product selection tests may create products dynamically; preexisting product records are optional.
These records are fallback demo suppliers for the product create/edit select only when the existing supplier mock storage does not already contain at least two valid Supplier records.
Before editing this file, inspect backend/app/models/supplier.py and preserve the current Supplier schema exactly.
Do not replace existing valid supplier records only to change demo names.
Do not introduce email or phone fields when the current Supplier model expects contact_email.
Browser/e2e should use supplier names/ids that are actually present in the rendered select, either from existing storage or from these fallback records.
